observations: Photo 0 shows the front of a black DSLR camera with 'Canon' on the prism and 'EOS 800D' on the body.
The lens in photo 0 is marked 'EFS 18-55mm' and has a Canon lens cap attached.
Photo 1 shows the rear of the camera with the articulating screen folded closed.
Photo 2 provides a side view confirming the 'EOS 800D' model name and showing 'AF/MF' and 'STABILIZER' switches on the lens barrel.
The camera is being held in a retail environment with other camera boxes (EOS 4000D, Nikon D700) visible in the background.

claims.evidence: The exterior appears clean in photos, but internal and functional condition is not shown.

risks.proof: A video showing the camera powering on, the LCD screen working, and taking a photo with flash.

risks.risk: Fungus, haze, or scratches on lens elements
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the front and rear lens glass elements.
A clear photo of the image sensor with the lens removed.
A screenshot of a shutter count diagnostic tool for this serial number.

proof_requests: Video of the camera powered on, showing the LCD screen and taking a test shot.
Photos of the front and rear lens glass.
Photo of the camera sensor with the lens detached.
response.reason: The camera and lens are clearly identified by brand and model. It will be priced at its worst-case (non-functional) value until proof of operation and optical clarity is provided.
